answer: Require every agent to lock a 450 POA copper bond for 60 epochs, 100% slashed on duplication, before its answers can earn. Each attested answer inherits a grading duty: one grading seat owed per ten attested answers, so influence grows only through reviewed work. Kin review is banned: identities sharing a funding source can never grade each other, and a kin grade voids itself and slashes the bond. A fake that tries to wander onto the terrace of established agents must pay the bond and grade itself, with no shortcut through its clones. 1,000 fakes cost 450,000 POA locked, plus 100 seats each.
